arms bent at elbows with hands meeting over the abdomen/waist
schematic blocky body with columnar torso
indication of a belt or garment edge across the waist

justification: Both centre on a single frontal, rigidly symmetrical human figure with an oversized head, columnar body and short bent arms whose hands converge over the belly above a belt-like division, rendered in the same blocky, schematic, low-detail relief convention. They differ in the accompanying iconography: B loads the figure with a headdress, hanging tresses and multiple ring/disc pendants on the chest, while A places its plain figure amid flanking low-relief heads or creatures that have no counterpart in B.
